scripts.link:cli: pnpm run build:cli && ln -sf "$PWD/packages/cli/dist/dhplan.js" "$PNPM_HOME/bin/dhplan" && echo "Linked dhplan -> $PNPM_HOME/bin/dhplan"
scripts.deploy: pnpm run test && pnpm run build:pwa && pnpm --filter @dh-care-plan/pwa run deploy
scripts.deploy:stage: pnpm run test && pnpm run build:pwa && pnpm --filter @dh-care-plan/pwa run deploy:stage
